questions.question: Which evidence profile can reach the STRONG confidence tier in score_hypothesis?
options: Two participants from one segment across one session
Three participants with seven snippets and no second segment
Five or more participants, at least two segments, and multi-session evidence
One participant with many snippets and a clear research label
questions.explanation: The strong branch requires all three conditions: at least five distinct participants, at least two segments, and evidence spanning multiple sessions.

questions.question: What tier and score does the Power users hypothesis receive?
options: STRONG at 0.80, because it has two segments
WEAK at 0.30, because it has fewer than five participants
ANECDOTE at 0.15, because it is about keyboard shortcuts
MODERATE at 0.66, because it has four participants and two segments
questions.explanation: Four participants enter the moderate branch. With two segments, the base is 0.62; one extra participant adds 0.04, giving 0.66.

questions.question: How does score_hypothesis classify evidence from one participant with several snippets?
options: ANECDOTE at 0.15
WEAK at 0.30
MODERATE at 0.50
STRONG at 0.80
questions.explanation: The single-participant check runs before the strong or moderate branches. It returns ANECDOTE with score 0.15 even when the snippet count is greater than one.

questions.question: Why does Scenario B trigger a representational-bias flag?
options: Power users contribute more snippets than new users
New users contribute 14 of 18 snippets, above 60%, while representing only 30% of the population
The cluster contains no enterprise users
Every segment has fewer than five snippets
questions.explanation: The new-user evidence share is 14/18, about 78%. It exceeds SKEW_THRESHOLD=0.60 while its population share is below POP_THRESHOLD=0.40.

questions.question: Which segment is listed as silent for Scenario B?
options: new-user
power-user
returning-user
enterprise-user
questions.explanation: Scenario B includes new-user, power-user, and enterprise-user evidence. returning-user is in ALL_SEGMENTS_IN_POOL but absent from the cluster.

questions.question: Which boundary does check_bias use for its skew flag?
options: It flags at exactly 40% evidence share when population share is 60%
It flags every segment with fewer than five snippets
It flags only when the total snippet count is zero
It flags evidence share strictly above 60% when population share is strictly below 40%
questions.explanation: The condition is evidence_share > SKEW_THRESHOLD and population_share < POP_THRESHOLD. Equality at either threshold does not trigger this flag.
